conditions.description: The broker message is acknowledged before charging or saving account state.
conditions.rationale: A failure after Ack can lose work because the broker has already been told the message completed.

conditions.description: payments.Charge receives account and amount but no message/idempotency key from this worker.
conditions.rationale: Retry calls Handle again, so an uncertain failure can repeat an externally visible charge unless an external provider control exists.

conditions.description: ReportedBalance and LastSequence are assigned without checking that message.Sequence is newer than the stored sequence.
conditions.rationale: A late older event can overwrite state established by a newer event.

conditions.description: The external charge occurs before account persistence with no compensation path in this worker.
conditions.rationale: If account save fails after a successful charge, external payment state and local account state can diverge.
A stable message identifier exists and should not be reported as entirely absent from the event contract.

conditions.description: The worker records the message ID in its audit entry after processing.
conditions.rationale: A correlation value is explicitly included in the audit event.

conditions.description: The broker's exact acknowledgement and redelivery guarantees are not established by this worker source.
Whether Payments.Charge independently deduplicates repeated charges is not established here.
conditions.rationale: Provider implementation and request semantics are outside the fixture.

conditions.description: The worker must not be cleared as safe under retries and partial failures.
conditions.rationale: Acknowledgement happens first, charging lacks a visible idempotency key, and cross-system compensation is absent.

conditions.description: The worker must not be cleared as preserving monotonic event order.
conditions.rationale: Sequence is stored but never compared before reported balance overwrites current account state.
